text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Vodka surges forward! A brilliant first place, she's as strong as ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I did it, I did it, I actually pulled it off...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose next time.
Next time, I'll definitely be number one. That's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's an absolute certainty...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on, Scarlet!
Next time, and the time after that, I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka really are amazing together...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean. No matter which of them wins,
it makes you look forward to what comes next!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating.
I couldn't reach it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...My resolve has hardened.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is my determination
to achieve even greater success moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It was Machan who chose the sprint division.
I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, as expected,
Vodka and Scarlet are formidable.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just having those two clash against each other
causes expectations for the race to skyrocket.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Then deeper and stronger than ever before.
I have to leave my mark,
the Aston Machan way."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...For now, it's the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

With that, Aston Machan suddenly began walking in the opposite direction of the inn we'd booked.
I hurry to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We are in Kyoto in the autumn.
We simply must take a commemorative photo with the autumn leaves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you coming too, Trainer?
Afterward, I enjoyed the crimson-tinted streets of Kyoto together with Aston Machan.
